name: Introduction to International Financial Management
description: This course aims to develop an understanding of international financial markets and foreign exchange mechanisms. It introduces students to global trade and financial flows, the structure and significance of the Balance of Payments, and key exchange rate theories such as PPP and IRP. The course further builds practical skills in analyzing spot and forward currency markets, arbitrage opportunities, and the use of derivatives including currency options and futures for risk management and international transaction pricing.
